name: io.github.PhillipChaffee/transaction-management-mcp
title: Transaction Management MCP
description: Read-only-by-default MCP for transaction management REST workflows.

environmentVariables.name: SKYSLOPE_TM_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: SkySlope API client id from API onboarding (not a normal account key).

environmentVariables.name: SKYSLOPE_TM_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: SkySlope API client secret from API onboarding.

environmentVariables.name: SKYSLOPE_TM_ACCESS_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Access key used with HMAC login.

environmentVariables.name: SKYSLOPE_TM_ACCESS_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Access secret used with HMAC login.

environmentVariables.name: SKYSLOPE_TM_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Toolset selection: default, all, or comma-separated toolset ids.

environmentVariables.name: SKYSLOPE_TM_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated extra tool names to register.

environmentVariables.name: SKYSLOPE_TM_EXCLUDE_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolset ids to exclude after selection.

environmentVariables.name: SKYSLOPE_TM_EXCLUDE_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool names to exclude after selection.

environmentVariables.name: SKYSLOPE_TM_READ_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set true to allow write tools (default false / read-only).

environmentVariables.name: SKYSLOPE_TM_ALLOW
environmentVariables.description: Capability grants: all or comma-separated capability ids.

environmentVariables.name: SKYSLOPE_TM_MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Max structured JSON response bytes before parse.

environmentVariables.name: SKYSLOPE_TM_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Max decoded upload bytes for base64 inputs.

environmentVariables.name: SKYSLOPE_TM_MAX_BULK_ITEMS
environmentVariables.description: Max bulk-export items returned to the host.
